CustomField.description: Addresses of Deleted Records: what happens to a household's, organization's or person's addresses when it is deleted. Delete (they are deleted with it and restored with it, the shipped choice, and what a blank means) or Keep (they stay, belonging to nobody). Canonical model R-AD11, D-184. Held as text because a custom setting field cannot be a picklist; the settings console offers the two values.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Delete: the addresses go to the Recycle Bin with the record and come back when it is restored. Keep: the addresses stay, belonging to nobody.
CustomField.label: Addresses of Deleted Records
